notes: Layer order is the enforcement direction: a module may only import modules in layers it lists in its layer's mayImport (plus its own layer). 'type' imports are exempt - they are erased at runtime and cannot create an init cycle.

bridgeSafe marks the modules that are copied into the packaged bridge sidecar (scripts/build-bridge-runtime.mjs copies server/ and src/shared/). Anything reachable at runtime from a bridge entry must be bridgeSafe, or the packaged app breaks while dev still works.

layers.title: Contracts
layers.summary: Type declarations only. Erased at runtime, importable from anywhere.

layers.title: Foundation
layers.summary: Locale and dictionaries. Pure lookups, no I/O, no persistence - persistence is injected by an adapter.

layers.title: Protocol
layers.summary: The declared boundaries: wire version, shell command ids, bridge endpoint surface. Shared by both runtimes.

layers.title: Kernel
layers.summary: Pure domain policy. Runs in the renderer and in the bridge; nothing here may touch React, the DOM, the network, or the filesystem.

layers.title: Bridge
layers.summary: The pi host and its HTTP/NDJSON/WS surface. Owns the filesystem, git, sqlite and the pi kernel.

layers.title: Shell
layers.summary: Window hosts (Electron main + preload) and packaging. Speaks the shell protocol only.

layers.title: Adapters
layers.summary: Outward-facing edges of the renderer: bridge transport, host invocation, notifications, preferences, perf.

layers.title: Presentation
layers.summary: React components, feature hooks and themes. Reaches the outside world through adapters only.

layers.title: App
layers.summary: Composition root. The one place allowed to wire every layer together.

layers.title: Tooling
layers.summary: Build, packaging, diagnostics and tests. Exempt from layer direction, still registered and size-checked.

protocols.title: Renderer ↔ Bridge
protocols.swap: Implement BridgeTransport (src/lib/bridge/transport.ts) and inject it with setBridgeTransport(). Nothing above the adapter names HTTP.

protocols.title: Renderer ↔ Window host
protocols.swap: Add a host by implementing the ipc surface for HOST_COMMAND_IDS and calling invokeHost() - call sites stay put.

protocols.title: Bridge ↔ pi kernel
protocols.swap: Every @earendil-works import the bridge needs is re-exported from server/piKernel.mjs. A kernel bump that moves or renames something inside dist/ is a one-file fix.

protocols.title: Bridge ↔ SQLite
protocols.swap: openSqliteDatabase() is the only place node:sqlite is named; the conveniences the callers expect are added there.
protocols.seamGap: openSqliteDatabase() 是唯一命名 node:sqlite 的地方，但还没有注入点（缺一个 setSqliteFactory()）；调用方直接拿单例，所以换驱动只能改文件、不能换实现

protocols.title: Renderer ↔ 性能探针
protocols.swap: Install a PerfPort with setPerfPort()（真实现是 src/lib/perf.ts，插槽在 src/lib/perf-port.ts）。请求路径只问当前装上的探针，不再摸 globalThis.__piDesktopPerf。

protocols.title: Renderer ↔ 本地存储
protocols.swap: 实现 KeyValueStorePort 并 setStoragePort()（真实现 src/lib/storage.ts，启动时 installStoragePort() 校验 schema 版本）。只有这一个文件碰 localStorage（规则 no-bypass）。

protocols.title: Renderer ↔ 语言偏好存储
protocols.swap: 实现 LocalePreferencePort 并用 installLocalePreferencePort() 接上（契约在 contracts 层，插槽是 src/i18n/index.ts 的 configureLocalePreference()）。

processBoundaries.why: 非渲染侧的运行时代码：桥（server/**）、宿主主进程与 preload（src-electron/**）、构建脚本（scripts/**）、e2e 夹具（e2e/**，只含 .mjs 那部分）。checkJs + 棘轮（规则 node-typecheck）
构建配置本身单独一份（composite，被 tsconfig.json 引用）
Rust 不适用 tsc：由 cargo check 检查，见 README 的 tauri:build

allowed.why: 唯一实现；其余代码走 getStoragePort()（协议 local-store）

bypassGuards.why: 散落的 localStorage 调用无法换宿主存储、无法在无 DOM 环境测试，也没有 schema 版本闸

allowed.why: 桥的 HTTP 实现本体（协议 bridge）
取图片二进制自己造 blob URL，不是桥的路由；桥只送 URL

bypassGuards.why: HTTP 语义只该有一个地方知道（状态码、ETag、NDJSON 分帧、诊断）

allowed.why: 宿主调用入口本体（协议 shell）；其余代码走 invokeHost()/invokeHostQuietly()

bypassGuards.why: 调用点自己直接调 invoke 会绕过命令白名单类型，也会让宿主的可替换性失效
